concerns.text: Task T017 (Merge Output) is missing. The spec requires a merged CSV output (US-1, FR-001/002) and the plan maps this to Phase 0/1, but the tasks list skips T017 entirely (jumps from T016 to T018). Without T017, the pipeline cannot produce the `merged_monthly.csv` required for US-2 (T020) and US-3 (T025).

Task T020 (Correlation Computation) is missing. The spec US-2 and FR-004/005 require Pearson correlation, lag windows, and bootstrap resampling. The tasks list jumps from T019 (Integration Test) to T021 (Bootstrap Correction), leaving the core correlation logic unassigned to any task.

Task T021 (Bootstrap Correction) is missing. The spec US-2 and FR-005 require multiple-comparison correction (Bonferroni/FDR) and bootstrap CIs. The tasks list jumps from T020 (which is missing) to T022 (Control Validation), leaving the statistical correction logic unassigned.

Task T022 (Control Validation) is missing. The spec US-2 and FR-008 require control region validation and noise-floor comparison. The tasks list jumps from T021 (missing) to T023 (Contract Test), leaving the control region logic unassigned.

Task T025 (Time-series Visualization) is missing. The spec US-3 and FR-007 require time-series overlays. The tasks list jumps from T024 (Integration Test) to T026 (Scatter Visualization), leaving the time-series plot generation unassigned.

Task T026 (Scatter Visualization) is missing. The spec US-3 requires scatter plots with regression lines. The tasks list jumps from T025 (missing) to T027 (Spatial Visualization), leaving the scatter plot generation unassigned.

Task T027 (Spatial Visualization) is missing. The spec US-3 requires spatial anomaly maps. The tasks list jumps from T026 (missing) to T028 (Sensitivity Analysis), leaving the spatial map generation unassigned.

Task T028 (Sensitivity Analysis) is missing. The spec US-3 and FR-006 require threshold sweeps and sensitivity reporting. The tasks list jumps from T027 (missing) to T029 (Temporal Bias), leaving the sensitivity report generation unassigned.

Task T029 (Temporal Bias Documentation) is missing. The spec FR-009 requires temporal aggregation bias documentation. The tasks list jumps from T028 (missing) to T030 (Output Validation), leaving the bias analysis unassigned.

Task T030 (Output Validation Test) is missing. The spec FR-007 requires validation of causal language absence. The tasks list jumps from T029 (missing) to T031 (Integration Test), leaving the output validation test unassigned.

Task T031 (Integration Test for Visualization) is missing. The spec US-3 requires independent testing of the visualization pipeline. The tasks list jumps from T030 (missing) to Phase 5, leaving the visualization integration test unassigned.

Task T032 (README.md) is missing. The plan and spec require a README with installation and run commands. The tasks list jumps from T031 (missing) to T033 (Run Contract Tests), leaving the documentation task unassigned.

Task T033 (Run Contract Tests) is missing. The plan requires verification of schema compliance. The tasks list jumps from T032 (missing) to T034 (Run Integration Tests), leaving the contract test execution unassigned.

Task T034 (Run Integration Tests) is missing. The plan requires end-to-end pipeline verification. The tasks list jumps from T033 (missing) to T035 (Measure Runtime), leaving the integration test execution unassigned.

Task T035 (Measure Runtime) is missing. The spec SC-004 requires runtime verification (≤6h). The tasks list jumps from T034 (missing) to T036 (Document Checksums), leaving the runtime measurement unassigned.

Task T036 (Document Checksums) is missing. The plan and Constitution Principle III require checksum documentation. The tasks list jumps from T035 (missing) to T037 (Verify URLs), leaving the checksum documentation unassigned.
Task T037 (Verify URLs) is missing. The plan requires dataset URL verification. The tasks list jumps from T036 (missing) to T038 (Update State), leaving the URL verification unassigned.

Task T038 (Update State) is missing. The plan and Constitution Principle V require state file updates. The tasks list jumps from T037 (missing) to T039 (Run Quickstart Validation), leaving the state update unassigned.

Task T039 (Run Quickstart Validation) is missing. The plan requires quickstart reproducibility validation. The tasks list jumps from T038 (missing) to T040 (Update Methodology), leaving the quickstart validation unassigned.

Task T041 (Update Correlation Docstring) is missing. The Einstein review resolution requires explicit frame-of-reference statements in code. The tasks list jumps from T040 (Update Methodology) to T042 (Update Sensitivity Report), leaving the correlation script update unassigned.

Task T042 (Update Sensitivity Report) is missing. The Einstein review resolution requires a 'Frame of Reference' section in the report. The tasks list jumps from T041 (missing) to T043 (Update Visualizations), leaving the report update unassigned.

Task T043 (Update Visualizations) is missing. The Einstein review resolution requires frame-of-reference footnotes in plots. The tasks list jumps from T042 (missing) to T044 (Update Control Validation), leaving the visualization updates unassigned.

Task T044 (Update Control Validation) is missing. The Einstein review resolution requires control region frame-of-reference verification. The tasks list jumps from T043 (missing) to T045 (Create Contract Test), leaving the control validation update unassigned.

Task T045 (Create Contract Test) is missing. The Einstein review resolution requires a test for frame-of-reference disclaimers. The tasks list jumps from T044 (missing) to T047 (Update Spec), leaving the contract test unassigned.
Task T047 (Update Spec) is missing. The Einstein review resolution requires updating the spec assumptions. The tasks list ends after T045, leaving the spec update unassigned.

Task T015 contains a malformed URL placeholder: 'Name or service not known)'))]'. This is a writing error in the task description that needs correction to a valid URL or placeholder format, though the intent (fetching GRACE-FO data) is clear.
